# CU-ID: arch
# CU-TYPE: ArchCU
# DTR-COORDINATES: 

Hexagonal architecture for the Scala Hypothesis Engine. Layer order DOMAIN, APPLICATION, INFRASTRUCTURE, CONTROL. Domain holds immutable models only. Application owns ports and services. Infrastructure provides adapters. Control performs DI wiring and CLI entry. No cross-layer imports: domain imports nothing from application/infrastructure/control; application imports domain only; infrastructure imports application and domain; control imports all. Dependencies are injected through constructors; no service locators. The ledger report is a read-only projection of ledger state built in application and encoded in control; it never decides an outcome. Severity: every CU is CRITICAL unless downgraded explicitly.

IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS:
1. Apply these rules to every file authored by this batch: domain at hypothesisengine/domain, application at hypothesisengine/application, infrastructure at hypothesisengine/infrastructure, control at hypothesisengine/control.

Prove: `grep -c 'package hypothesisengine' hypothesis-engine/src/main/scala/hypothesisengine/domain/Model.scala` prints 1.

Do NOT touch: hypothesis-engine/src/test/**, .LLMDD/**

Stop when: every authored source file sits in its layer package and no import crosses a layer boundary.

# CU-ID: legend
# CU-TYPE: LegendCU
# DTR-COORDINATES: 

LEGEND for feat-18. CU means Computational Unit. CU folder is the per-CU directory named after the cu id. COORDINATES.itr names the baseline DTR keys the CU touches. REQUIREMENTS.itr names the feature criteria the CU delivers. IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS.itr holds numbered steps, each with an exact file path, a complete fenced code block, a Prove line, a Do NOT touch list and a Stop when line. ACCEPTANCE.itr names the spec test ids with commands and expected results. Hypothesis is a candidate correctness claim carrying an Advisor-authored justification. Gate floor is the inclusive engine minimum of 0.85 for gate_probability_for_correctness. LedgerStageReport is the read-only per-stage projection of ledger state containing the hypothesis, its coordinates, justification, posterior, gate, gap, decision and cumulative StageDecision history. Stage is one engine invocation, numbered by the count of prior decision records plus one. Conversation record is the feature artifact holding verbatim report echoes. Report echo is the exact report block pasted into the design conversation. Verdict line is the GREEN_LIGHT, RED_LIGHT or ADVISOR_ACTION_REQUIRED line printed by the engine.

IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS:
1. Apply this legend when reading any CU frame in this batch.

Prove: `grep -c 'LedgerStageReport' .LLMDD/ITRS/feat-18-raise-hypothesis-gate-and-print-ledger/LEGEND.itr` prints 1.

Add an Advisor-authored justification to the Hypothesis value and define the report vocabulary: StageDecision, BreakpointView, LedgerStageReport and ExaminationOutcome. The justification default keeps older five-argument call sites compiling until they are amended by cu-005; a blank value fails closed at evaluation time in cu-002. Depends on: nothing.

```scala
package hypothesisengine.domain

import java.time.Instant

opaque type HypothesisId = String
object HypothesisId:
  def apply(value: String): HypothesisId = value
  def value(id: HypothesisId): String = id

opaque type DtrCoordinate = String
object DtrCoordinate:
  def apply(value: String): DtrCoordinate = value
  def value(coordinate: DtrCoordinate): String = coordinate

opaque type ExecutionId = String
object ExecutionId:
  def apply(value: String): ExecutionId = value
  def value(id: ExecutionId): String = id

enum Runtime:
  case Python, Scala

final case class Hypothesis(
  id: HypothesisId,
  statement: String,
  coordinates: Vector[DtrCoordinate],
  gate: Double,
  prior: Double,
  justification: String = ""
)

final case class ExperimentDefinition(
  experimentId: String,
  hypothesisId: HypothesisId,
  runtime: Runtime,
  command: Vector[String],
  workingDirectory: String,
  timeoutSeconds: Int,
  testArtifactVersion: String
)

final case class RawResult(
  executionId: ExecutionId,
  hypothesisId: HypothesisId,
  experimentId: String,
  testArtifactVersion: String,
  command: Vector[String],
  sourceRevision: String,
  timeoutSeconds: Int,
  exitCode: Int,
  stdout: String,
  stderr: String,
  durationMillis: Long,
  recordedAt: Instant
)

final case class NormalizedResult(
  executionId: ExecutionId,
  hypothesisId: HypothesisId,
  passed: Boolean,
  detail: String
)

final case class Breakpoint(
  coordinate: DtrCoordinate,
  executionId: ExecutionId,
  detail: String
)

final case class SuggestedFix(
  targets: Vector[DtrCoordinate],
  description: String
)

final case class AdvisorActionRequired(
  missing: Vector[String],
  corrections: Vector[String]
)

final case class ProbabilityCalculation(
  hypothesisId: HypothesisId,
  posterior: Double,
  calculatedAt: Instant
)

enum Decision:
  case Green(hypothesisId: HypothesisId, posterior: Double, gate: Double)
  case Red(hypothesisId: HypothesisId, posterior: Double, gate: Double, breakpoints: Vector[Breakpoint], fix: SuggestedFix)
  case Blocked(reason: AdvisorActionRequired)

final case class StageDecision(
  stage: Int,
  posterior: Double,
  gate: Double,
  decision: String
)

final case class BreakpointView(
  coordinate: String,
  executionId: String,
  detail: String
)

final case class LedgerStageReport(
  stage: Int,
  hypothesisId: String,
  statement: String,
  dtrCoordinates: Vector[String],
  justification: String,
  probabilityForCorrectness: Double,
  gate: Double,
  gap: Double,
  decision: String,
  breakpoints: Vector[BreakpointView],
  fix: Option[String],
  history: Vector[StageDecision]
)

final case class ExaminationOutcome(
  decision: Decision,
  report: LedgerStageReport
)
```

```scala
package hypothesisengine.application

import hypothesisengine.domain.*
import java.time.Instant

object LedgerValidator {
  val gateFloor: Double = 0.85d

  def requireComplete(missing: Vector[String]): Either[AdvisorActionRequired, Unit] =
    if missing.isEmpty then Right(())
    else Left(AdvisorActionRequired(missing, missing.map(name => "supply " + name + " to the ledger before examination")))

  def requireAdmissible(hypothesis: Hypothesis): Either[AdvisorActionRequired, Unit] =
    val floorMissing: Vector[String] =
      if hypothesis.gate >= gateFloor then Vector.empty[String]
      else Vector("gate_probability_for_correctness >= " + gateFloor.toString)
    val floorCorrections: Vector[String] =
      if hypothesis.gate >= gateFloor then Vector.empty[String]
      else Vector("raise gate_probability_for_correctness to at least " + gateFloor.toString + " (found " + hypothesis.gate.toString + ")")
    val justificationMissing: Vector[String] =
      if hypothesis.justification.trim.nonEmpty then Vector.empty[String]
      else Vector("justification")
    val justificationCorrections: Vector[String] =
      if hypothesis.justification.trim.nonEmpty then Vector.empty[String]
      else Vector("supply a non-empty Advisor-authored justification for the hypothesis")
    val missing: Vector[String] = floorMissing ++ justificationMissing
    val corrections: Vector[String] = floorCorrections ++ justificationCorrections
    if missing.isEmpty then Right(()) else Left(AdvisorActionRequired(missing, corrections))
}

object BayesianEvaluator {
  private val concentration: Double = 2.0d

  def update(prior: Double, results: Vector[NormalizedResult]): Double =
    val passes: Double = results.count(_.passed).toDouble
    val total: Double = results.length.toDouble
    (prior * concentration + passes) / (concentration + total)

  def record(hypothesisId: HypothesisId, posterior: Double, at: Instant): ProbabilityCalculation =
    ProbabilityCalculation(hypothesisId, posterior, at)
}

object RemediationReporter {
  def breakpointsFor(hypothesis: Hypothesis, results: Vector[(RawResult, NormalizedResult)]): Vector[Breakpoint] =
    results.filterNot((_._2.passed)).zipWithIndex.map { case ((raw, normalized), index) =>
      val coordinate: DtrCoordinate = hypothesis.coordinates.lift(index)
        .getOrElse(hypothesis.coordinates.headOption.getOrElse(DtrCoordinate("UNKNOWN")))
      Breakpoint(coordinate, raw.executionId, normalized.detail)
    }

  def suggest(hypothesis: Hypothesis, breakpoints: Vector[Breakpoint]): SuggestedFix =
    val targets: Vector[DtrCoordinate] = breakpoints.map(_.coordinate).distinct
    SuggestedFix(targets, "Revise the implementation at " + targets.map(DtrCoordinate.value).mkString(", ") + " using the failing evidence recorded on the breakpoints, then re-run the experiments for " + HypothesisId.value(hypothesis.id))
}

object ExaminationGate {
  def blocked(hypothesis: Hypothesis, reason: AdvisorActionRequired): Decision =
    Decision.Blocked(reason)

  def decide(hypothesis: Hypothesis, posterior: Double, results: Vector[(RawResult, NormalizedResult)]): Decision =
    if posterior >= hypothesis.gate then Decision.Green(hypothesis.id, posterior, hypothesis.gate)
    else
      val breakpoints: Vector[Breakpoint] = RemediationReporter.breakpointsFor(hypothesis, results)
      Decision.Red(hypothesis.id, posterior, hypothesis.gate, breakpoints, RemediationReporter.suggest(hypothesis, breakpoints))
}
```

```scala
package hypothesisengine.application

import hypothesisengine.domain.*

object StageReporter:
  def build(
    hypothesis: Hypothesis,
    decision: Decision,
    priorHistory: Vector[StageDecision]
  ): LedgerStageReport =
    val stage: Int = priorHistory.length + 1
    val posterior: Double = decision match
      case Decision.Green(_, value, _) => value
      case Decision.Red(_, value, _, _, _) => value
      case Decision.Blocked(_) => 0.0d
    val gate: Double = decision match
      case Decision.Green(_, _, value) => value
      case Decision.Red(_, _, value, _, _) => value
      case Decision.Blocked(_) => hypothesis.gate
    val label: String = decision match
      case Decision.Green(_, _, _) => "GREEN"
      case Decision.Red(_, _, _, _, _) => "RED"
      case Decision.Blocked(_) => "BLOCKED"
    val breakpoints: Vector[BreakpointView] = decision match
      case Decision.Red(_, _, _, values, _) => values.map { breakpoint =>
        BreakpointView(
          coordinate = DtrCoordinate.value(breakpoint.coordinate),
          executionId = ExecutionId.value(breakpoint.executionId),
          detail = breakpoint.detail
        )
      }
      case _ => Vector.empty[BreakpointView]
    val fix: Option[String] = decision match
      case Decision.Red(_, _, _, _, suggestion) => Some(suggestion.description)
      case _ => None
    val current: StageDecision = StageDecision(stage, posterior, gate, label)
    LedgerStageReport(
      stage = stage,
      hypothesisId = HypothesisId.value(hypothesis.id),
      statement = hypothesis.statement,
      dtrCoordinates = hypothesis.coordinates.map(DtrCoordinate.value),
      justification = hypothesis.justification,
      probabilityForCorrectness = posterior,
      gate = gate,
      gap = gate - posterior,
      decision = label,
      breakpoints = breakpoints,
      fix = fix,
      history = priorHistory :+ current
    )
```

4. Write hypothesis-engine/src/main/scala/hypothesisengine/infrastructure/SqliteLedger.scala with the exact content below (complete file). Only saveHypothesis and the new decisionHistory differ from the baseline:

```scala
package hypothesisengine.infrastructure

import hypothesisengine.application.Ledger
import hypothesisengine.domain.*
import java.nio.file.{Files, Paths}
import java.sql.{Connection, DriverManager, PreparedStatement}
import java.time.Instant
import scala.util.{Failure, Success, Using}

final class SqliteLedger(dbPath: String = "ledger.db") extends Ledger:
  private val schema: String =
    Option(getClass.getResourceAsStream("/ledger-schema.sql")) match
      case Some(stream) => scala.io.Source.fromInputStream(stream).mkString
      case None => ""

  private def connection: Connection = DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:sqlite:" + dbPath)

  initializeSchema()

  private def initializeSchema(): Unit =
    val attempt = Using.Manager { use =>
      val conn: Connection = use(connection)
      val statement = use(conn.createStatement())
      schema.split(";").foreach { part =>
        if part.trim.nonEmpty then statement.execute(part)
      }
    }
    attempt match
      case Failure(error) => throw error
      case Success(_) => ()

  private def write(sql: String)(bind: PreparedStatement => Unit): Either[String, Unit] =
    Using.Manager { use =>
      val conn: Connection = use(connection)
      val statement: PreparedStatement = use(conn.prepareStatement(sql))
      bind(statement)
      statement.executeUpdate()
    } match
      case Success(_) => Right(())
      case Failure(error) => Left(error.getMessage)

  private def count(sql: String)(bind: PreparedStatement => Unit): Int =
    Using.Manager { use =>
      val conn: Connection = use(connection)
      val statement: PreparedStatement = use(conn.prepareStatement(sql))
      bind(statement)
      val resultSet = use(statement.executeQuery())
      if resultSet.next() then resultSet.getInt(1) else 0
    }.getOrElse(0)

  override def saveRaw(result: RawResult): Either[String, Unit] =
    write("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO executions (id, hypothesis_id, experiment_id, artifact_version, command, revision, timeout_seconds, exit_code, stdout, stderr, duration_millis, recorded_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)") { statement =>
      statement.setString(1, ExecutionId.value(result.executionId))
      statement.setString(2, HypothesisId.value(result.hypothesisId))
      statement.setString(3, result.experimentId)
      statement.setString(4, result.testArtifactVersion)
      statement.setString(5, result.command.mkString(" "))
      statement.setString(6, result.sourceRevision)
      statement.setInt(7, result.timeoutSeconds)
      statement.setInt(8, result.exitCode)
      statement.setString(9, result.stdout)
      statement.setString(10, result.stderr)
      statement.setLong(11, result.durationMillis)
      statement.setString(12, result.recordedAt.toString)
    }

  override def saveNormalized(result: NormalizedResult): Either[String, Unit] =
    write("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO evidence (execution_id, hypothesis_id, passed, detail) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)") { statement =>
      statement.setString(1, ExecutionId.value(result.executionId))
      statement.setString(2, HypothesisId.value(result.hypothesisId))
      statement.setInt(3, if result.passed then 1 else 0)
      statement.setString(4, result.detail)
    }

  override def saveCalculation(calculation: ProbabilityCalculation): Either[String, Unit] =
    write("INSERT INTO calculations (hypothesis_id, posterior, calculated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)") { statement =>
      statement.setString(1, HypothesisId.value(calculation.hypothesisId))
      statement.setDouble(2, calculation.posterior)
      statement.setString(3, calculation.calculatedAt.toString)
    }

  override def saveDecision(hypothesisId: HypothesisId, decision: Decision): Either[String, Unit] =
    val label: String = decision match
      case Decision.Green(_, _, _) => "GREEN"
      case Decision.Red(_, _, _, _, _) => "RED"
      case Decision.Blocked(_) => "BLOCKED"
    val gate: Double = decision match
      case Decision.Green(_, _, value) => value
      case Decision.Red(_, _, value, _, _) => value
      case Decision.Blocked(_) => 0.0d
    val posterior: Double = decision match
      case Decision.Green(_, value, _) => value
      case Decision.Red(_, value, _, _, _) => value
      case Decision.Blocked(_) => 0.0d
    write("INSERT INTO decisions (hypothesis_id, decision, gate, posterior) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)") { statement =>
      statement.setString(1, HypothesisId.value(hypothesisId))
      statement.setString(2, label)
      statement.setDouble(3, gate)
      statement.setDouble(4, posterior)
    }

  override def saveHypothesis(hypothesis: Hypothesis): Either[String, Unit] =
    write("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO hypotheses (id, statement, gate, prior, justification) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)") { statement =>
      statement.setString(1, HypothesisId.value(hypothesis.id))
      statement.setString(2, hypothesis.statement)
      statement.setDouble(3, hypothesis.gate)
      statement.setDouble(4, hypothesis.prior)
      statement.setString(5, hypothesis.justification)
    }

  override def saveCoordinates(hypothesisId: HypothesisId, coordinates: Vector[DtrCoordinate]): Either[String, Unit] =
    write("DELETE FROM coordinates WHERE hypothesis_id = ?") { statement =>
      statement.setString(1, HypothesisId.value(hypothesisId))
    }.flatMap { _ =>
      coordinates.foldLeft[Either[String, Unit]](Right(())) { (acc, coordinate) =>
        acc.flatMap { _ =>
          write("INSERT INTO coordinates (hypothesis_id, coordinate) VALUES (?, ?)") { statement =>
            statement.setString(1, HypothesisId.value(hypothesisId))
            statement.setString(2, DtrCoordinate.value(coordinate))
          }
        }
      }
    }

  override def saveExperiments(hypothesisId: HypothesisId, definitions: Vector[ExperimentDefinition]): Either[String, Unit] =
    write("DELETE FROM experiments WHERE hypothesis_id = ?") { statement =>
      statement.setString(1, HypothesisId.value(hypothesisId))
    }.flatMap { _ =>
      definitions.foldLeft[Either[String, Unit]](Right(())) { (acc, definition) =>
        acc.flatMap { _ =>
          write("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO experiments (id, hypothesis_id, definition, artifact_version) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)") { statement =>
            statement.setString(1, definition.experimentId)
            statement.setString(2, HypothesisId.value(definition.hypothesisId))
            statement.setString(3, definition.command.mkString(" "))
            statement.setString(4, definition.testArtifactVersion)
          }
        }
      }
    }

  override def missingFor(hypothesis: Hypothesis, experiments: Vector[ExperimentDefinition]): Vector[String] =
    val id: String = HypothesisId.value(hypothesis.id)
    val missing: Vector[String] = Vector(
      if count("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hypotheses WHERE id = ?")(statement => statement.setString(1, id)) == 0 then "hypothesis record" else "",
      if count("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coordinates WHERE hypothesis_id = ?")(statement => statement.setString(1, id)) == 0 then "DTR coordinate references" else "",
      if count("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM experiments WHERE hypothesis_id = ?")(statement => statement.setString(1, id)) == 0 then "experiment definition" else "",
      if experiments.isEmpty then "probability calculation inputs" else ""
    ).filter(_.nonEmpty)

      var index: Int = 0
      while resultSet.next() do

        buffer += StageDecision(index, resultSet.getDouble(3), resultSet.getDouble(2), resultSet.getString(1))
      buffer.result()
    }.getOrElse(Vector.empty[StageDecision])

    val tables: Vector[String] = Vector("executions", "evidence", "calculations", "coordinates", "experiments")
    tables.foreach { table =>
      write("DELETE FROM " + table + " WHERE hypothesis_id = ?") { statement =>
        statement.setString(1, id)
      }
    }
    ()
```

```scala
final class HypothesisEngine(runner: ProcessRunner, ledger: Ledger, clock: Clock):
  def execute(hypothesis: Hypothesis, definitions: Vector[ExperimentDefinition]): ExaminationOutcome =
    val priorHistory: Vector[StageDecision] = ledger.decisionHistory(hypothesis.id)
    val decision: Decision =
      LedgerValidator.requireAdmissible(hypothesis) match
        case Left(reason) => Decision.Blocked(reason)
        case Right(_) =>
          ledger.resetStageData(hypothesis.id)
          ledger.saveHypothesis(hypothesis)
          ledger.saveCoordinates(hypothesis.id, hypothesis.coordinates)
          ledger.saveExperiments(hypothesis.id, definitions)
          definitions.foreach { definition =>
            val raw: RawResult = runner.run(definition)
            ledger.saveRaw(raw)
            ResultNormalizer.validate(raw) match
              case Right(normalized) => ledger.saveNormalized(normalized)
              case Left(error) => System.err.println("REJECTED " + error)
          }
          LedgerValidator.requireComplete(ledger.missingFor(hypothesis, definitions)) match
            case Left(reason) =>
              val blocked: Decision = ExaminationGate.blocked(hypothesis, reason)
              ledger.saveDecision(hypothesis.id, blocked)
              blocked
            case Right(_) =>
              val results: Vector[(RawResult, NormalizedResult)] = ledger.resultsFor(hypothesis.id)
              val posterior: Double = BayesianEvaluator.update(hypothesis.prior, results.map((_._2)))
              ledger.saveCalculation(BayesianEvaluator.record(hypothesis.id, posterior, clock.now()))
              val decided: Decision = ExaminationGate.decide(hypothesis, posterior, results)
              ledger.saveDecision(hypothesis.id, decided)
              decided
    ExaminationOutcome(decision, StageReporter.build(hypothesis, decision, priorHistory))
```

```scala
final class FixedClock extends Clock:
  override def now(): Instant = Instant.parse("2026-01-01T00:00:00Z")

final class ScriptedRunner(results: Vector[RawResult]) extends ProcessRunner:
  private var index: Int = 0
  override def run(definition: ExperimentDefinition): RawResult =
    val result: RawResult = results(index % results.length)
    index = index + 1
    result

final class MemoryLedger(var missing: Vector[String] = Vector.empty) extends Ledger:
  val rawRows: scala.collection.mutable.ArrayBuffer[RawResult] = scala.collection.mutable.ArrayBuffer.empty

  val decisionRows: scala.collection.mutable.ArrayBuffer[(HypothesisId, Decision)] = scala.collection.mutable.ArrayBuffer.empty
  override def saveRaw(result: RawResult): Either[String, Unit] = { rawRows += result; Right(()) }
  override def saveNormalized(result: NormalizedResult): Either[String, Unit] = { normalizedRows += result; Right(()) }
  override def saveCalculation(calculation: ProbabilityCalculation): Either[String, Unit] = { calculationRows += calculation; Right(()) }
  override def saveDecision(id: HypothesisId, decision: Decision): Either[String, Unit] = { decisionRows += ((id, decision)); Right(()) }
```

```python
"""Tests for the deterministic hypothesis report echo checker."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import subprocess
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Sequence

ROOT: Path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
TOOL: Path = ROOT / ".LLMDD" / "tools" / "check-hypothesis-report.py"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Case:
    """One table-driven checker case."""

    name: str
    verdict: str
    with_report: bool
    echo: str
    expected_ok: bool
    expected_reason: str


def block(stage: int, decision: str) -> str:
    return json.dumps(
        {"stage": stage, "decision": decision, "hypothesis_id": "H-CASE"},
        separators=(",", ":"),
        sort_keys=True,
    )


CURRENT: str = block(2, "RED")
PRIOR: str = block(1, "RED")

CASES: Sequence[Case] = (
    Case("verbatim echo passes", "RED_LIGHT", True, CURRENT, True, ""),
    Case("missing report fails", "RED_LIGHT", False, CURRENT, False, "report-file-missing"),
    Case("non-verbatim echo fails", "RED_LIGHT", True, CURRENT + " ", False, "verbatim-echo-missing"),
    Case("missing echo fails", "RED_LIGHT", True, "", False, "verbatim-echo-missing"),
    Case("mismatched verdict fails", "GREEN_LIGHT", True, CURRENT, False, "verdict-mismatch"),
)


def run_case(case: Case, tmp_path: Path) -> tuple[int, str]:
    report: Path = tmp_path / "case.ledger-report.jsonl"
    conversation: Path = tmp_path / "case.hypothesis-conversation.md"
    if case.with_report:
        report.write_text(PRIOR + "\n" + CURRENT + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    conversation.write_text(case.echo, encoding="utf-8")
    completed: subprocess.CompletedProcess[str] = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(TOOL), "--report", str(report), "--conversation", str(conversation),
         "--stage", "2", "--verdict", case.verdict],
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
    )
    return completed.returncode, completed.stdout + completed.stderr


def test_checker_table(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    case: Case
    for case in CASES:
        code: int
        output: str
        code, output = run_case(case, tmp_path)
        assert (code == 0) is case.expected_ok, case.name + " " + output
        if not case.expected_ok:
            assert case.expected_reason in output, case.name + " " + output
```
